summary: Alibaba Group Holding Ltd filed a Form 6-K with the SEC, furnishing a monthly return on movements in its authorized share capital and issued shares, as required by Hong Kong Stock Exchange Rule 13.25B. The filing shows no changes in authorized share capital and a minor increase in issued shares (668,000 shares) from share option exercises, with no treasury shares. This is a routine regulatory compliance filing, not a special situation. No deal terms, board recommendations, or advisors are mentioned. Watch for ongoing capital management activities.
